@everyone

Earlier this morning, our community lead “Steve Corn Pops” discord account was compromised by what we believe to be from a bookmarklet attack, which bypassed best practice security measures. 

What we know:
Once Steve's account was compromised, “fake Steve” sent an invite to two accomplices. These accomplices joined the server and were given a high-ranking role with the ability to delete channels, change/add roles, ban/kick members. These scammers then began working their way through discord trying to cover their tracks by deleting and changing roles/channels. 

Then came the announcement from “fake Steve” about a free mint. I’ll pause here… so that it is known, I have made multiple announcements throughout the history of our server about security and scams. We have stated so many times that we will NEVER sporadically have an unscheduled NFT collection mint. 

Luckily, 99.9% of you immediately red-flagged the announcement and swiftly took action in chat, and warned everyone of the scam. We thank all of you for taking action on this!! 

Moving Forward
Up to this point, we as a team have always taken security measures extremely seriously. Even with this recent event, I am proud of our security practices thus far. Yes, a team member was unfortunately attacked and we know how to defend ourselves against this attack and many others going forward. We are also taking additional precautions that will further tighten up our security and will be kept internal for obvious reasons. 

We have so many things coming up that are extremely exciting. Let’s collectively learn from this and grow together and stronger! This incident is a blip in our history and will NOT stop us from continuing onward and upward. 

Server invites are currently paused for safety so that we can ensure no stones have been unturned. We will open invites back up once we feel everything has been restored to it’s original state.

In Conclusion
In the wild world of crypto, you are your own bank. That is the freedom that crypto provides, but there of course are the drawbacks of handling your own security. This should be a stark reminder for everyone reading this that no one is immune to cyber attacks and that we should ALL pay attention to each and every message that relates to sales, NFTs, airdrops, etc. 

BE SMART, BE DILIGENT, USE COMMON SENSE. If anything appears too good to be true, then it is more than likely a SCAM.

Cornucopians,
We are excited to announce that we will be having a vehicle sale soon (yes a real sale)! 

But first, we will be having our annual OG claim event so that we can test the marketplace platform. This year, OGs will be gifted the very limited edition… Bubblejett Bonanza OG Custom! This will be a 48hr event starting on July 5th - TIME TBD


Now, back to the juicy details…
The vehicle being sold will be the 2023 Valley Raceworx T3. This vehicle will be our fastest vehicle yet and fills a slot in our A-Class lineup. Why another vehicle you might ask? For our game to be attractive and ultimately succeed, it is critical that we release content in the form of game assets so that our game is balanced, attractive to new users, and provides enough variety to capture mainstream gamers. That being said, we aim to adopt a traditional gaming asset release schedule that is consistent, fresh, and fun. The sooner we can do this, the sooner we can begin pushing our game into marketing campaigns that will attract more gamers.

To ensure that we have a balanced variety between vehicle classes (A, B, C) we decided that the T3 would be a great option to introduce for launch.
